# openporch Provider

Manages the platform-side objects of an [openporch](https://github.com/krisbrud/openporch) organization: applications, environments, resource definitions and their criteria, cloud accounts, values and access. Deployments are not resources; use `porch score deploy` or `porch workload deploy` for those.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    openporch = {
      source = "openporch/openporch"
    }
  }
}

# Each argument may be left out and taken from OPENPORCH_URL, OPENPORCH_ORG and
# OPENPORCH_TOKEN instead.
provider "openporch" {
  url    = "https://porch.example.com"
  org_id = "acme"
  token  = var.openporch_token
}

variable "openporch_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) The organization ID. Defaults to `OPENPORCH_ORG`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) An API token for a service user. Defaults to `OPENPORCH_TOKEN`.
- `url` (String) The server URL, such as `https://porch.example.com`. Plain `http` is only allowed for loopback addresses. Defaults to `OPENPORCH_URL`.
